title: Unbounded Antilinear Operators on Hilbert Spaces
summary: The paper introduces unbounded antilinear operators on Hilbert spaces and develops their fundamental theory. In particular, we establish a closed range theorem, a polar decomposition theorem, and the convexity of the numerical range for antilinear operators. Furthermore, we present several new results on antilinear normal operators and provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a minimal antilinear normal extension of an antilinear subnormal operator.
